summary: Make shuttle bay an actual bay (with floors!) instead of empty space

comments.content:
This'd make it somewhat harder to screw over everyone by sucking the air
out of shuttle bay or walling it off/welding airlocks shut (which has
always struck me as a cop-out) and would also allow for cool sliding doors
when the shuttle was about to arrive or leave (you could reuse some of the
air tunnel code). That'd be hella rad.
